title.narrative: Scaling universal access to safe and climate resilient water services in Rwanda

description.narrative: The SCALE project aims to accelerate water coverage in Nyagatare, Rwamagana and 12 other urban branches outside Kigali and reach universal access in the coming five to seven years in line with the SDG6 policies of the Government of Rwanda. This will be achieved by a combination of master- and investments planning, demonstrating and upscaling (innovative) service models and water storage, non-revenue water (NRW) reduction and water safety planning.The project will demonstrate climate resilience service models and provide first time access to at least 100,000 people in small towns in Rwamagana and Nyagatare Districts. In addition, the project will introduce and showcase water safety planning and significantly reduce NRW (from over 45% to 30% or less). Country-wide upscaling of the results will be achieved by benchmarking among the 14 branches.Last but certainly not least, SCALE will support improvements in the enabling by supporting improving Monitoring & Evaluation by the Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority (RURA) / Ministry of Infrastructure.
